sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def redinfo(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='R':
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (n['pixels'],min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
def ppos(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b' and 20<=n['pixels']<=30:
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (round((min(rows)+max(rows))/2), round((min(cols)+max(cols))/2))
    return None
# go to (10,40)
for a in ['UP']*5+['RIGHT']*4:
    action([a])
print('at',ppos(current_frame),'red',redinfo(current_frame))
# probe DOWN one at a time
for i in range(9):
    before=ppos(current_frame)
    action(['DOWN'])
    after=ppos(current_frame)
    print('DOWN',i+1,before,'->',after,'red',redinfo(current_frame))
    if after==before:
        print('BLOCKED at',after); break
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        print('DONE'); break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<parameter=code>
def redinfo(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='R':
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (n['pixels'],min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
def ppos(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b' and 20<=n['pixels']<=30:
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (round((min(rows)+max(rows))/2), round((min(cols)+max(cols))/2))
    return None
# go to (10,40)

    action([a])

# probe DOWN one at a time
for i in range(9):
    before=ppos(current_frame)
    action(['DOWN'])
    after=ppos(current_frame)
    print('DOWN',i+1,before,'->',after,'red',redinfo(current_frame))
    if after==before:
